rawFindings.title: Breaking change in PostAsset.path causing asset_img tag test failures
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces path joining of post.path and slug (which preserves spaces and does a simple file path join) with url.resolve(), which treats second argument as an absolute URL if starting with '/' or relative URL otherwise. This leads to unexpected behavior especially with slugs containing spaces or special characters, breaking current functionality and causing tests to fail.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to the original implementation that uses pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) to generate PostAsset.path, ensuring consistent file path concatenation as before.

rawFindings.title: Test coverage reduced removing asset with spaces test
rawFindings.explanation: The test 'with space' which covers assets with spaces in slug and title is removed. This reduces test coverage on handling spaces in asset paths and titles, which was relevant given the code change impacting path resolution.
rawFindings.suggestion: Retain or add back the test case for assets with spaces to ensure the feature works correctly and regressions are caught.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect usage of url.resolve for constructing asset paths
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaces pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) with url.resolve(post.path, this.slug). url.resolve is meant to resolve URLs, not filesystem paths, and it treats the second argument as an absolute or relative URL, which can yield unexpected results. For example, if this.slug starts with '/', url.resolve will ignore post.path and return this.slug only. The previous use of pathFn.join correctly joined filesystem paths and is appropriate if post.path and slug are filesystem paths.
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to using pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug) for the PostAsset.path virtual getter to correctly join paths without unexpected URL resolution behavior.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect usage of url.resolve causing path joining issues
rawFindings.explanation: In lib/models/post_asset.js, the code replaces 'pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug)' with 'url.resolve(post.path, this.slug)'. However, url.resolve treats the second argument as a full URL path and may remove parts of the first argument if the second argument does not start with './' or does not conform to expectations. This changes the original behavior where post.path and slug were simply joined as file paths. This can lead to incorrect paths being generated for the PostAsset path virtual, poten
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original implementation with 'return pathFn.join(post.path, this.slug);' to correctly join the file paths as before.
